book.necromancy.guide.1:
§4§lThe Necronomicon§r

The art of reanimation.

Gather flesh, sew new bodies from the creatures of the world, bind a soul to them and raise Minions that obey you alone.

Read on, if you dare.
book.necromancy.guide.10:
§4Work§r

Told to Work at a chest, a Minion does what its body allows:

§lFarmer§r: a villager head and a hoe.
§lCollector§r: two Enderman arms.
§lReaper§r: a scythe in hand; it keeps two of each animal and culls the rest.
book.necromancy.guide.11:
§4The Phylactery§r

Bind a Minion to a §lPhylactery§r with a sneak-use. If it dies it leaves Remains: put them in the altar's soul slot with a Jar of Blood to raise it again, kills and all.

The Phylactery also calls it back to your side.
book.necromancy.guide.12:
§4The Rite§r

At a Tier III shrine, at night or in a storm, an §lOminous Bottle§r and a Jar of Blood on an empty altar begin the Rite.

What answers is no servant. Kill the Abomination and take its Legendary heart.

§8Thus ends the book.§r
book.necromancy.guide.2:
§4Flesh§r

Creatures you or your Minions kill sometimes leave §lorgans§r: brains, a heart, lungs, muscle and skin. Some are richer in one organ than others; a ghast is mostly lung.

Looting, or Reaping on a scythe, finds more. Leather becomes Skin in the Sewing Machine.
book.necromancy.guide.3:
§4Blood and Souls§r

Use a §lBone Needle§r on a living creature while you carry a Glass Bottle to draw a Jar of Blood.

Kill a creature with a §lscythe§r while you carry an empty bottle and its soul fills it. The stronger the creature, the stronger the soul.
book.necromancy.guide.4:
§4The Sewing Machine§r

Iron, string and a Bone Needle make the machine. Put a needle and string in it, then sew heads, torsos, arms and legs on its 4x4 grid.

Every stitch uses a string and wears the needle. A part's tooltip tells you what it gives a Minion.
book.necromancy.guide.5:
§4The Summoning Altar§r

Place planks with two cobblestone in a row beside them, then use this book on the planks. The book is spent; the altar remains.

It holds blood, a soul, and a body: head, torso, legs and two arms.
book.necromancy.guide.6:
§4Raising§r

A body needs at least a head, a torso and legs. Every part has a weight, and a soul can only lift a body as heavy as its potency allows.

Sneak and use the altar, or press Raise in its screen. Your Minion awaits your bidding.
book.necromancy.guide.7:
§4The Shrine§r

The dead are drawn to dark places. Lit candles, soul lights, pools of blood and mob heads within four blocks of the altar give it power.

Tier I keeps 3 Minions, Tier II 5 and Tier III 8. The altar's screen shows your shrine.
book.necromancy.guide.8:
§4Commanding§r

The §lBone Scepter§r gives orders. Use it on your Minions to select them; use it in the air to pick an order, then on a block to give it: Follow, Stay, Guard, Patrol or Work.

Sneak and use it in the air to change their stance.
book.necromancy.guide.9:
§4Care§r

Sneak with an empty hand on a Minion to arm and armour it. Rotten flesh, organs and Jars of Blood mend it; it heals standing in blood.

Saddle a pig, cow, spider or squid torso and steer it with a Brain on a Stick. Minions grow stronger with every kill.

jei.necromancy.info.altar:
To build a Summoning Altar, place any planks with two cobblestone in a row beside them, then use the Necronomicon on the planks. The book is consumed and the three blocks become the altar.

Lay a head, a torso, arms and legs on it, add a Jar of Blood and a Soul in a Jar, and raise your Minion. Candles, soul lights and mob heads around the altar let you keep more Minions.
jei.necromancy.info.jar_of_blood: Use a Bone Needle on a living creature while carrying an empty Glass Bottle to draw a Jar of Blood.
jei.necromancy.info.organs: Organs come from creatures killed by you or your Minions: brains, hearts, muscle and lungs. Skeletons, golems, slimes and spirits have none. Some creatures are richer in one organ than others: villagers and illagers in brains, hoglins in hearts, ghasts in lungs.
jei.necromancy.info.skin: Skin is cut from leather on the Sewing Machine: one leather gives eight pieces.
jei.necromancy.info.soul_in_a_jar: Carry an empty Glass Bottle and land the killing blow with a scythe: the creature's soul is caught in the bottle. Stronger creatures give stronger souls, which can animate heavier bodies.
jei.necromancy.sewing.needle: Needs a Bone Needle in the needle slot; each stitch wears it down
jei.necromancy.sewing.thread: Uses up one String per stitch
